plainText:
The Beginning of the End with Kyogre & Groudon VIII (Japanese: VS カイオーガ & グラードン VIII VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII), titled VS Kyogre & Groudon VIII in the Chuang Yi translation, is the 244th chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 64th chapter of the .

It is subtitled Fighting Spirit (Japanese: 戦う意志のもとに Battle As One) in the VIZ Media translation and Battle As One in the Chuang Yi translation.

==Plot==
 
On top of the wreckage of the Submarine Explorer 1, a startled wakes up. He remembers the last words Archie told him before locking him in the Submarine Explorer 1 and sending it to the bottom of the water. Amber immediately shakes it off as a misunderstanding and goes to help his teammates raise the sea level.

Elsewhere, Blaise and Tabitha continue traveling on , where they are joined by Courtney. At 's location, it continues to easily overpower Brawly and Roxanne with its attacks. After defeating Brawly's , Groudon attempts to leave the battle. Roxanne immediately stops its movements with her 's . Although not her style of battling, Roxanne has her Pokémon continuously attack Groudon, preventing it from fighting back.

Suddenly, a voice from above praises Roxanne's skills and sends out a to attack Groudon with . The voice is revealed to be that of Wallace, who came to help them stop Groudon. Before they can continue, three figures arrive and tell the Gym Leaders that if they intend on stopping Groudon, they'll have to face them first.
